about: The Workbench icons of the AriaMaestosa drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/ariamaestosa.png, beamed notes over a keyboard drawn as 32 x 32 pixel art, shown at 128 x 128) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files.
